_comment: Single source of truth for the QEMU/OVMF machine matrix.
docs/toolchain.md refer here instead of repeating the numbers.

configs.name: normal
configs.note: Hardware target is 4 CPU / 4096 MiB (docs/hardware-target.md); mem is capped at 3072 MiB because the reference dev sandbox host has 3.9 GiB RAM and cannot back a 4 GiB guest. Raise mem_mib on larger hosts.

configs.name: upper
configs.note: run-qemu.sh profile for manual use on big hosts; not part of the automated sandbox matrix.
